title: Verify text authoring and shared-scene previews
description: Verify serialized template and project values, authoritative scene geometry, visible label and sheet previews, autosave recovery, undo/redo, and zoom independence through public contracts and user flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract checks cover strict template decoding, exact revision resolution, stable position assignments, scene output, diagnostics, and serialization round trips
A browser flow selects an exact revision, creates text, assigns a position, and shows matching label and sheet preview content
Autosaved template and assignment identities recover after a browser restart
Undo and redo affect visible content during the session while reload resets history
Viewport resize and zoom change display scale but not scene geometry or wrapping
Unsupported payloads and missing revisions show actionable refusals
Build, lint, unit/integration, and focused Playwright checks pass

steps.details: Define compact valid and invalid template, exact revision, assignment, bundled metrics, and expected printable-scene fixtures with stable identifiers.
Assert strict decode/encode, exact reference behavior, deterministic scene geometry, structured diagnostics, and rejection of raw CSS or executable fields.
Use keyboard-accessible controls to choose a revision, create text, set typography, assign a position, and compare visible content and geometry-backed attributes in both previews.
Exercise edit, undo, redo, durable save, and context restart, asserting recovered values and reset transient history, zoom, and focus state.
Capture the scene before and after viewport/zoom changes, assert equality, then trigger missing-revision and unsupported-payload refusals through public boundaries.
Run build/type checking, lint, unit/integration tests, and focused Playwright tests; resolve failures without asserting component internals.

technicalNotes: Tests should compare public serialized values and scene contracts, not React implementation details.
This closes PRD 16 and provides the validated scene boundary required by PDF generation.
